posts.alt: MemoryCare: A check-in before an alert. If a possible fall is detected, MemoryCare asks "Are you OK?" before telling anyone. Join the waitlist, link in bio.
posts.instagram:
If the phone detects a possible fall, MemoryCare checks in first. The screen asks "Are you OK?" with a countdown, and if there is no answer in time, caregivers are alerted. Fall detection can miss a fall or raise an alarm when nothing happened, and it needs the phone to be on, charged and connected.

Join the waitlist: https://getmemorycare.app/ (link in bio)
